mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QUERY_REQUEST ( REQUEST_ID, REQUEST_NO, DRAFTER_ID, DEPT_ID, TITLE, PURPOSE ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{requestNo}, #{drafterId}, #{deptId}, #{title}, #{purpose, jdbcType=CLOB} )

SELECT SEQ_QUERY_ITEM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO QUERY_ITEM ( QUERY_ID, REQUEST_ID, QUERY_ORDER, QUERY_TITLE, SQL_TEXT, AUTHORING_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{queryId}, #{requestId}, #{queryOrder}, #{queryTitle}, #{sqlText, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{authoringType} )
mapper.select: SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_ITEM I WHERE I.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID ) AS SQL_COUNT FROM QUERY_REQUEST R WHERE R.DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId} ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REQUEST_ID DESC

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, U.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.SUBMITTED_AT FROM QUERY_REQUEST R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId}

SELECT I.QUERY_ID, I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_TITLE, I.SQL_TEXT, I.AUTHORING_TYPE, I.VALIDATION_STATUS, I.ITEM_CLASS FROM QUERY_ITEM I JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = I.REQUEST_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.DRAFTER_ID = #{drafterId} ORDER BY I.QUERY_ORDER
